## ERYTHRASMA
Erythrasma presents as brownish-red, well circumscribed, irregularly shaped
patches in or near skin folds. Patches in the groin often itch.
Most cases respond to topical therapy.
## Treatment
## Inpatient

/Outpatient [Clindamycin 1% topical solution apply twice daily [M] for 14 days](psjzid-clindamycin-1-topical-soln-q12h)
